scope: Screen GDAL's separate libopencad DWG route as an optional independent parser, evaluate a newly surfaced ACIS/B-rep Rust fork's lineage, refresh the ACadSharp solid-writer follow-up, and reconcile current parser-safety/recovery guidance against existing plan owners.

method.kind: Public primary project documentation, repository lineage metadata, current issues and pull requests
method.evidenceBoundary: Repository READMEs, official GDAL driver documentation, project lineage metadata, and issue/PR state are discovery and route-scope evidence only. No executable capability, independent ACIS module provenance, parsed drawing, shape validity, native acceptance, or local regression was verified.

evidence.observed: The GDAL CAD driver is based on its internal libopencad implementation, is read-only, and documents POINT, LINE, CIRCLE, ARC, and 3DFACE projections. The linked libopencad project says only DWG R2000 is currently supported. GDAL's ODA-backed DWG driver and DXF driver are distinct routes.
doesNotEstablish: successful runtime support for all AC1015 files or all entity fields
owner graph, opaque object, or exact wire preservation
evidence.planUse: Optional composed AC1015 reader differential for the documented basic geometry subset and 3DFACE only, if GDAL CAD and a provenance-qualified input are already available. First verify libopencad source lineage before counting it as an independent parser. Capture the exact selected GDAL driver and output projection; otherwise mark NOT_RUN.

evidence.topic: cadcodec/opencadcodec ACIS claim and reader lineage
evidence.observed: The cadcodec repository advertises SAT/SAB read/write, B-rep topology, primitive builders, and broad DWG/DXF support. GitHub metadata identifies cadcodec as a fork of opencadcodec, and opencadcodec as a fork of ACadRust. No source or binary was inspected or run.
doesNotEstablish: independent provenance of the ACIS parser/kernel module
valid closed solids or producer/native-CAD acceptance
the exact source commit, build features, or repeatable results
evidence.planUse: Do not count this project as a second outer-format parser. Retain as an optional ACIS source-inspection lead only after exact revision pinning and separate code-lineage audit of the ACIS module; require analytic geometry and independent shape checks before semantic use.

evidence.observed: Issue #1195 still reports silent omission of 3DSOLID/REGION in the retrieved view. Linked PR #1240 remains open, depends on ACDS/ACIS schema work, and describes DXF ACIS entity output plus detailed DWG ModelerGeometry serialization. The retrieved view does not establish merge, release, or deployment.
doesNotEstablish: output acceptance in AutoCAD, ODA, or another native CAD system
a libdxfrw bug or shared failure
evidence.planUse: Retain the existing record-to-callback-to-owner-to-writer-to-carrier-to-semantic acceptance stages and pin an exact release/branch if later used. No duplicate ACIS finding is created.

evidence.topic: Current LibreDWG safety fixes and ezdxf repair boundary
evidence.observed: LibreDWG 0.14.1 NEWS lists peer-specific security/correctness fixes involving decompression capacity and logical size, page offsets, checked size products, ACIS block bounds, non-finite normalization loops, and entity/handle relationships. ezdxf documentation distinguishes ordinary reads from slower recovery/audit and warns that recovered drawings with unrecoverable decode errors may lose or invalidate data when saved.
doesNotEstablish: that a peer's mitigation or limit is normative for libdxfrw
that repaired/recovered output is a clean interoperability pass
evidence.planUse: Confirms existing PAR-14/PAR-15/7S.3 and scheduled fuzz/sanitizer owners. Add only source-mapped local controls when modifying an analogous path; keep strict parse, pre-repair projection, audit, and recovery diagnostics as distinct evidence.

nextActions: Continue local implementation without waiting for these optional peer routes.

At a composed AC1015 comparator checkpoint only, use GDAL CAD/libopencad if already available and only with provenance-qualified input; do not install a new comparator dependency or commit its generated files.
Record exact GDAL driver identity because CAD/libopencad, DWG/ODA, and DXF are not interchangeable.
Treat cadcodec/opencadcodec as ACadRust-descended for outer format parsing; audit ACIS module code lineage independently before any semantic use.
Do not promote J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, or J295 from this source-only review.
